sources.entry: Microsoft Azure: $100 in Azure credit to use on AI/ML services, databases, and more, plus free access to dozens of services. No credit card required.

summary.name: Azure for Students
summary.one_liner: Microsoft's free student tier of Azure cloud, giving university students a $100 credit, free monthly service amounts, and bundled developer tools without a credit card.
use_cases: Building and hosting student cloud projects
Experimenting with Azure OpenAI and AI/ML services
Data science coursework on cloud infrastructure
Learning cloud computing with Microsoft Learn paths
Downloading free developer tools like Visual Studio Code and SQL Server Developer
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a free Azure account for full-time university students, signed up with a school email and renewable yearly while the person remains a student. It includes a $100 credit usable within 12 months on most Azure products, plus free monthly amounts of 20+ popular services for 12 months and 65+ always-free services. Students can access the full Azure catalog up to those limits. The Azure Dev Tools for Teaching program offers free downloads of developer software such as Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio Community, SQL Server Developer and Windows Server, obtained via the Azure Education Hub. Free Microsoft Learn training modules are also linked.
notable: $100 credit with no credit card required
Renewable yearly while enrolled as a student
Bundled free developer tools via Azure Dev Tools for Teaching
Access to Azure OpenAI and AI/ML services
caveats: Only available to full-time university students, and one account per person
Credit usable within 12 months and not for Azure Marketplace offers
After credits or student status end, the subscription moves to pay-as-you-go or is disabled
